items.title: Book Recommendation: Life in Perspective
items.author: Scott Young
items.description: We rarely notice what's closest to us. Perspective is hard to gain, but it is worth cultivating. Here's how. The post Book Recommendation: Life in Perspective appeared first on Scott H Young .
items.summary: An old fish swims by two young fish and says, “Morning boys, how’s the water?” After he passes by, one young fish looks at the other and says, “What the heck is water?” The joke points to an important truth: we rarely notice what’s closest to us. The traits we have that are most obvious to others are often invisible to us.

items.author: WonJun Moon, Seongchan Kim, Dahun Kim, Seungryong Kim
items.description: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. items.summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text.
